name: system.power.reboot
description: Initiates an OS-level reboot. With `delay_seconds: 0`, the connection may drop before any response. With `delay_seconds > 0`, the OK with `scheduled_at` arrives before the reboot is issued. Extra-risky (X) verb; agents may require an elevated tier or explicit policy grant before honouring it.

delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before initiating reboot. Zero means immediate.

force_close_apps.description: Force-close applications without prompting. Maps to EWX_FORCE on Windows.

reason.description: Free-form reason logged with the reboot event. Surfaced in Windows Event Log.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the OS-level reboot will fire. Equals now+delay_seconds. Only present when delay_seconds > 0.

windows-modern.description: InitiateSystemShutdownExW with bRebootAfterShutdown=TRUE. Requires SeShutdownPrivilege (auto-enabled if held). Connection drops once the OS issues the reboot.

windows-classic.description: ExitWindowsEx(EWX_REBOOT [| EWX_FORCE]) on NT 4 / 2000 / XP / Vista / 7 / 8.x.
